dedupe_keys.name: future ecological risk due to river flow alteration in east anglia uk using cs n0w projected river flow data as part of stars4water

description: The STARS4Water project publishes ecological-flow risk results for 13 East Anglia catchments using CS-N0W daily river-flow projections. The public README describes the Ecological Risk due to Flow Alteration method, which compares flow indicators under a 1989 to 2018 baseline with two future periods, 2040 to 2059 and 2060 to 2079. Two UKCP18 ensemble members are crossed with sustainability-first, business-as-usual and economic-growth abstraction scenarios. The ZIP and README are public under Zenodo CC BY 4.0. These risk classes could constrain abstraction or environmental-flow decisions in a catchment simulation. They are derived indicators, not the underlying daily discharge series or a verified model of ecological population response. The related upstream CS-N0W dataset has a separate DOI and rights. The README was read, but the small ZIP was not opened; individual fields and catchment identifiers remain unchecked. No catalogue record explicitly covers this scenario collection.
name: Future ecological risk due to river flow alteration in East Anglia, UK using CS-N0W projected river flow data as part of STARS4Water
